\chapter{Build the Language Label and Values}
\label{ch:pa-form-language-pieces}
\hlchaptermodality{16}

\begin{chapteropening}
\textbf{By the end of this chapter:} \emph{I can build the Gurmukhi language label and guided-copy two separately practised language values after learning every new script piece one at a time.}

The learner builds \pa{ਭਾਸ਼ਾ}, \pa{ਪੰਜਾਬੀ}, and \pa{ਹਿੰਦੀ} only after each new Gurmukhi piece has received its own tiny introduction.
\end{chapteropening}

\section[bha]{\pa{ਭ} — one new base for the next label}

\label{lesson:PA-W03-bha}



\begin{quote}
Keep only the familiar long-vowel mark \textbf{\pa{ਾ}} in view. Today adds one base letter.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script — one tiny step}
Trace \textbf{\pa{ਭ}} slowly once, then once more. Say \emph{bha}. Do not attach a vowel mark yet.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Complete one careful attempt. Compare only the new shape or word, repair one difference, and stop.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
No later answer in this lesson adds a new spelling.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[sha]{\pa{ਸ਼} — one dotted sound}

\label{lesson:PA-W03-sha}



\begin{quote}
Point once to \textbf{\pa{ਭ}}, then put it away. This session adds only \textbf{\pa{ਸ਼}}.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script — one tiny step}
Trace \textbf{\pa{ਸ਼}} once. Its dot belongs to the letter. Compare it with familiar \textbf{\pa{ਸ}}, then cover the comparison.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Complete one careful attempt. Compare only the new shape or word, repair one difference, and stop.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
No later answer in this lesson adds a new spelling.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[bhāshā]{\pa{ਭਾਸ਼ਾ} — assemble the language label}

\label{lesson:PA-W03-language-label}



\begin{quote}
Touch the two new bases in order: \textbf{\pa{ਭ}}, then \textbf{\pa{ਸ਼}}. The long-vowel mark is already familiar.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script — one tiny step}
Build \textbf{\pa{ਭਾ} + \pa{ਸ਼ਾ} = \pa{ਭਾਸ਼ਾ}}. On a form, \textbf{\pa{ਭਾਸ਼ਾ}} asks which language belongs on the line. Copy the label once, then leave the answer line empty.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Complete one careful attempt. Compare only the new shape or word, repair one difference, and stop.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
No later answer in this lesson adds a new spelling.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[pa]{\pa{ਪ} — first piece of \pa{ਪੰਜਾਬੀ}}

\label{lesson:PA-W03-pa}



\begin{quote}
Read \textbf{\pa{ਭਾਸ਼ਾ}} as language. Now hide it; this session adds one value-letter.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script — one tiny step}
Trace \textbf{\pa{ਪ}} once, say \emph{pa}, and stop. The complete language name comes later.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Complete one careful attempt. Compare only the new shape or word, repair one difference, and stop.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
No later answer in this lesson adds a new spelling.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[tippi]{\pa{ੰ} — the nasal mark inside \pa{ਪੰਜਾਬੀ}}

\label{lesson:PA-W03-tippi}



\begin{quote}
Write \textbf{\pa{ਪ}} once. Today adds only the nasal mark that sits above it.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script — one tiny step}
Place \textbf{\pa{ੰ}} above \textbf{\pa{ਪ}} to make \textbf{\pa{ਪੰ}}. This is \emph{ṭippī}, not the final-position bindi from \textbf{\pa{ਹਾਂ}}.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Complete one careful attempt. Compare only the new shape or word, repair one difference, and stop.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
No later answer in this lesson adds a new spelling.
\end{tcolorbox}

\section[panjābī]{\pa{ਪੰਜਾਬੀ} — the Punjabi value}

\label{lesson:PA-W03-punjabi}



\begin{quote}
Touch the pieces without writing: \textbf{\pa{ਪੰ} · \pa{ਜਾ} · \pa{ਬੀ}}.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script — one tiny step}
Assemble \textbf{\pa{ਪੰਜਾਬੀ}} and copy it once with the model visible. This supported copy teaches the value; it is not independent writing evidence.

\subsection*{Your turn}

\section[sihari]{\pa{ਿ} — a mark written before, read after}

\label{lesson:PA-W03-sihari}



\begin{quote}
Write familiar \textbf{\pa{ਹ}} once.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script — one tiny step}
Add \textbf{\pa{ਿ}} to make \textbf{\pa{ਹਿ}}. Sihari is drawn to the left of its base but read after it: \emph{hi}.

\subsection*{Your turn}

\section[hindī]{\pa{ਹਿੰਦੀ} — the Hindi value}

\label{lesson:PA-W03-hindi}



\begin{quote}
Point once to \textbf{\pa{ਭਾਸ਼ਾ}} and say language. Point once to \textbf{\pa{ਪੰਜਾਬੀ}} and say Punjabi. Touch \textbf{\pa{ਭ}}, \textbf{\pa{ਸ਼}}, then the pieces of the Hindi value: \textbf{\pa{ਹਿ} · \pa{ਂ} · \pa{ਦੀ}}.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script — one tiny step}
Assemble \textbf{\pa{ਹਿੰਦੀ}} and copy it once with the model visible. Keep the tippi above the first unit and the long \textbf{\pa{ੀ}} on \textbf{\pa{ਦ}}.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Complete one careful attempt. Compare only the new shape or word, repair one difference, and stop.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
No later answer in this lesson adds a new spelling.
